C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 517
15/8/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

15th August 1916.

Sir,

It is reported that Deputy Military Governor
Lu is recruiting at Woosung, although he has no
authority from the Central Government to do so. He
has enrolled many of the ex-soldiers, who are
recently discharged by the revolutionists.

It is reported that General Yang will soon
leave for Peking.

The Ward Police arrested yesterday a robber
who is said to be a member of a gang which operated
in the City.

Your obedient servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

[批注符号]

Captain Superintendent of Police.

[手写批注，难以辨认]
pages.zh:
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 517 号
16/8/15

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916 年 8 月 15 日。

先生：

据报，副督军卢永祥虽未获中央政府授权，仍在吴淞招兵。他已招募许多近期被革命党人遣散的退伍士兵。

据报，杨将军不久将赴北京。

各区巡捕房昨日逮捕了一名劫匪，据悉此人是活跃于华界的一个帮派成员。

您忠顺的仆人，

[签名]

总探长。

[批注符号]

警务处总监。

[手写批注，难以辨认]
